headline: Transfer rumors, news: Spurs to make late move for Pulisic?
description: The deadline for the summer window in Europe closes tomorrow, and Tottenham Hotspur are interested in AC Milan winger Christian Pulisic. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Summer transfer window: Grading big signings in men's soccer
description: The 2026 summer transfer window is open. Here is how we rated the biggest deals.

headline: Bradley Barcola joins Liverpool in £123m move from Paris Saint-Germain
description: Liverpool have confirmed the signing of forward Bradley Barcola from Paris Saint-Germain.

headline: Liverpool closing in on £30m Lucca Brughmans deal - sources
description: Liverpool are closing in on a deal to sign goalkeeper Lucca Brughmans from Belgium side Genk, sources told ESPN.

headline: Man City announce signing of Allan Elias from Palmeiras
description: Manchester City have completed the signing of winger Allan Elias from Palmeiras, the club have announced.
